create_ReplayBuffer: create a ReplayBuffer with a fixed capacity to store transitions using a FIFO replacement policy
add_ReplayBuffer_element: add an element to the ReplayBuffer, replacing the oldest entry when the buffer is full
sample_ReplayBuffer: sample a specified number of elements uniformly from the ReplayBuffer
reset_ReplayBuffer: reset the ReplayBuffer to clear all stored elements and restore it to an empty state
iterate_ReplayBuffer: iterate over all elements in the ReplayBuffer using standard Python iteration
